capabilities: Sync a vault with a Git remote
Commit, pull, merge, and push manually
Review and resolve conflicting note edits
Recover previous file versions from checkpoints
extras: Distributed on GitHub and not submitted to the Obsidian community directory; desktop only; plugin ID changed from vault-git-sync, with a migration script for settings and hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through the user's own Git repository, and manual Git commands are error-prone for note conflicts and attachments.

relations.evidence: This is the desktop companion to VaultBridge for iPhone. Both use your own repository.
Git LFS support and compatibility with your existing Git credentials and remote.

summary: Git-based desktop sync plugin that saves, merges, uploads, and verifies a vault against a Git remote, with manual Git controls and recovery.
